name: nxsched_foreach

ownership.argument: Visits live TCBs under scheduler/interrupt protection. Visitor may inspect and retain file references but must not allocate, duplicate files, or invoke driver open/close. Callback(tcb,arg), no early stop.

provenance.source: Exact Q66 .155 IDB recovery for fd-independent QJS event-loop notification, 2026-10-30; native async wake EBADF captured at C3F5758.

notes: Exact .155 private ABI for owner-loop pipe lookup. TCB+100 TLS -> taskinfo -> UV key at 200BD444 -> uvstate+664 default loop. Matched TCB+8 group; group+96 filelist. Entry bytes: 2d e9 f0 47 06 46 00 af 88 46 ef f3. No fixed PID or caller-group fd assumption.
